increment_focus.name: Foundational Integration + Basic Mob
increment_focus.goal: Validate Foundry API and deliver core mob coordination

discovery_approach.rationale: Increment 1 has critical technical risk (Foundry API integration). Need detailed understanding of API interactions, data flows, and integration points before implementation.

story_map_structure.approach: Maintain story map hierarchy from shape phase
story_map_structure.elaboration: Add detailed descriptions, acceptance criteria, and technical notes to existing stories
story_map_structure.no_new_stories: Do not add new stories - discovery elaborates existing 11 stories from prioritization

documentation_strategy.story_format: Individual markdown files per epic/sub-epic with all stories detailed
content_per_story: Technical notes (APIs, data structures, integration points)

phase_1.name: API Foundation
phase_1.validation: Can we call Foundry APIs and get expected data?
phase_1.completion_criteria: All 4 Foundry sub-systems integrated and tested

phase_2.name: Mob Creation
phase_2.validation: Can GM create mob from selected tokens?
phase_2.completion_criteria: Mob data structure created and persisted

phase_3.name: Coordinated Attack
phase_3.validation: Does clicking one minion trigger coordinated mob attack?

critical_risks.risk: Foundry API doesn't support required features
critical_risks.validation: Spike/prototype API calls before full implementation

critical_risks.risk: Mob coordination performance issues with many minions
critical_risks.mitigation: Test with realistic mob sizes (5-10 minions) early

critical_risks.risk: Event system doesn't provide needed hooks
critical_risks.mitigation: Identify required Foundry hooks in Phase 1
critical_risks.validation: Document all hooks and test each one

coverage: Edge cases (no targets, single minion mob, etc.)
acceptance_criteria_approach.example: Given a mob with 3 minions exists, When GM clicks any minion in the mob, Then all 3 minions execute melee attack on selected target

assumptions.foundry_api_available: Foundry VTT v11+ API documentation is available and accessible
assumptions.development_environment: Local Foundry VTT instance available for testing
assumptions.no_foundry_module_conflicts: No other modules interfere with mob functionality
assumptions.gm_has_permissions: GM role has required permissions for token manipulation and action execution
assumptions.minions_are_actors: All minions are standard Foundry actors with combat capabilities

open_questions: Which Foundry VTT version should we target? (v11, v12, latest?)
How do we handle minions in different combat states (different initiatives)?
Should mob persist across game sessions or just for current session?
How do we handle minions being defeated - remove from mob automatically?
What happens if GM tries to create mob with non-minion tokens?
